existingTestIssues.observed: First full run failed in fetch with bad port; the test binds a random local port using listen(0). Exact allocated port was not logged.
existingTestIssues.attribution: Not a new account fix regression; neither auth test nor auth runtime was edited in this work.

manuallyReviewed: Owner/profile, player and FK lock ordering across account patch, recharge, delete and create.
Deferred constraint COMMIT rejection and lock timeout release; edits, prune and money log rollback; queue recovery.
All five queued account snapshot publication paths, failed deletes and delete during rollback.
Versioned snapshot generation fences, shared rejection recovery, clone isolation, cold outage and confirmed empty.
A8 bundle ACCOUNT save and refresh sequence, matching existing frontend call order and 120-180 second delay.
limits: Existing backend 16 skips, frontend 1 skip, resolver 1 expected fail retained.
No production or authenticated live-venue E2E validation.
Explicit database COMMIT rejection tested; ambiguous network failure at commit needs separate idempotency/reconciliation design.
Existing stale-read fallback and intermediate balance-cache refresh semantics preserved; no global strong consistency claim.
Existing random-port Cookie test instability recorded and not fixed in this review.
